people.name: Jesus
people.line: The Son of God and Savior of the world.

translations.web: and to wait for his Son from heaven, whom he raised from the dead: Jesus, who delivers us from the wrath to come.
translations.bsb: and to await His Son from heaven, whom He raised from the dead—Jesus our deliverer from the coming wrath.
translations.kjv: And to wait for his Son from heaven, whom he raised from the dead, even Jesus, which delivered us from the wrath to come.
translations.asv: and to wait for his Son from heaven, whom he raised from the dead, even Jesus, who delivereth us from the wrath to come.
